svg.title: Two probes: the new one must connect, the old one must be refused
svg.text: One client that can only do the new. One that can only do the old.
on the container it was applied to
old clients still get classical keys
each probe about 1 s; a second witness of another kind enumerates every group, 21 to 31 s,
and the pair runs again after the service is recreated
